If anyone affected can [compile Godot from source](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/development/compiling/compiling_for_windows.html) locally, there are two things which might help debug this further greatly.

1. Compile with `debug_symbols=yes` to get a proper backtrace when it crashes (if it doesn't print it properly, you might want to look into hooking up a debugger to the Godot process). A backtrace should already give us a good hint as to what may have caused the regression.
2. Otherwise, the most surefire way to find it is to [bisect the regression](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/workflow/bisecting_regressions.html). You'd identify the two closest snapshots where one works and the next fails, get their commit hashes (e.g. by running each with `--version`), and bisect between those two commits.

Small update on this, @BlueCube3310 was able to reproduce the issue briefly and track down the root of the problem: initializing a Vulkan context when running an OpenGL context can cause a crash. That happens in the following situations:
1. When opening the project manager (to determine whether Forward+ or Mobile projects can be created)
2. When baking LightmapGI
3. When importing VRAM compressed textures and "compress with GPU" is enabled.

Point 1 and 3 were added in 4.4 and contribute to why this issue has become more frequent in 4.4 dev builds. 

The issue does not appear with any particular driver update or device. The risk seems to be there with any recent NVidia driver. Once you start getting hit by the issue, it doesn't go away, although it is slightly random, it reproduces frequently. 

**At this point the only known solution is to do a clean reinstall of your drivers.**

That's likely mean this PR done nothing for you and something else fixed the crash (driver update?). V1 was expected to either disable project creation (if it detected a driver issue) or crash on VRAM compression (if it did not).

Unless VRAM Compression was not affected by the issue in the first place, it's possible the crash was only happening when OpenGL is freshly initialized (like in project manager).
